background._comment: Today background framing. scale >= 1 zooms the cover-fit image; offsetY in dp shifts it (negative = up). The code clamps offsetY so the image always fills the frame: |offsetY| <= (scale - 1) * screenHeight / 2.

egg._comment: Whole egg stage (glow + glass + shell): scale around centre, offsetY in dp (negative = up).

membrane._comment: Glass dome + ripple rings RELATIVE to the egg: scale around centre, offsetY in dp.

homeEgg._comment: Today-only scale and placement relative to the fixed hero stage. Positive vertical values lower the egg without moving its Kingdom environment.

homeHatchCountdown._comment: Today-only countdown placement below the egg. Positive values lower the panel relative to the fixed hero stage.

hexNeighborhood._comment: Today day-tile world row. Distances use Kingdom's floating-neighborhood-v2 projected neighbour vector. Edge targets cover the visible neighbour and surrounding vertical overscan while leaving the selected hero centre interactive.

homeEnvironment._comment: Today-only global environment framing. fitToViewport is the compact whole-tile experiment; disable it to restore the close-up zoom camera. The tile remains the anchor for its resident and egg.

homeKatchimera._comment: Home/Today-only framing for hatched Katchimeras. verticalLiftCreatureHeightRatio lifts relative to rendered creature height; nameCardOffsetY moves the title card down in dp; nameCardAdditionalStageHeightRatio adds a responsive offset based on the Today hero stage. Kingdom placement is unchanged.
